name: Developer Verification Campaign
author: Engine Systems Architect
description: Comprehensive testbed campaign engineered to exercise all core RPG systems: open-world freedom, NPC combat and death, multi-table loot, lockpicking, interactive objects, multi-phase bosses, faction dynamics, and persistent world consequences.

factions.name: Haven Free Citizens
factions.description: Townsfolk, traders, and artisans of the Haven settlement.

factions.name: Haven Town Watch
factions.description: Armed constabulary enforcing law, order, and tax collection in Haven.

factions.name: Shadow Syndicate
factions.description: Renegades, smugglers, and bandits operating from the ruined crypt.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Merchant Lycus falls dead in a pool of blood! The shop's heavy iron shutters slam shut permanently. Word spreads rapidly: Haven Watch Captain is conducting a murder investigation!

addJournalChronicle.title: Murder of Merchant Lycus
addJournalChronicle.text: Slew the prominent Haven merchant Lycus. The shop is shuttered and the town watch is on high alert.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Scholar Elena drops lifeless. Her research journal rolls across the floor. You can search her body to discover the notes she was guarding, unlocking an alternate path for the Sunstone quest!

addJournalChronicle.title: Death of Scholar Elena
addJournalChronicle.text: Scholar Elena was slain. Her research notes on the Sunstone can be retrieved directly from her belongings.
